title: cause_analysis
description: Why it broke, how far it reached, and what the fix is. The gate reads these; the narrative is the body.

item.description: The work item this analyses. The analysis is a fact about the item; the item is the record of the incident.

signal_fingerprint.description: The dedup key of the signal that raised the item, so the analysis can be found from the alarm.

severity.description: As resolved from policy on the item. Proposing a different one here is a reclassification a person confirms; it does not change the item.

cause.description: One sentence. What was wrong, not what was observed.

impact.description: Who or what was affected, and how far.

contributing_factors.description: The table under *Contributing factors* in the document.

evidence.description: A fact a reader can re-derive: a log line, a metric, a commit.

fix_plan.description: The table under *Fix plan* in the document. Each step names the kind of act, so the authority check can read it.

evidence.description: What will show this step was done — a merged change, a deploy event, an alarm back to OK.
